description: Assuming GCH, aleph one to the aleph zero is aleph one, aleph omega to the aleph zero is aleph at omega plus one, and aleph two to the aleph three is aleph four.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ContinuumFunction.gch_examples.{u} (h : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.GCH) :
  Cardinal.aleph 1 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 = Cardinal.aleph 1 ∧
    Cardinal.aleph Ordinal.omega0 ^ Cardinal.aleph0 = Cardinal.aleph (Ordinal.omega0 + 1) ∧
      Cardinal.aleph 2 ^ Cardinal.aleph 3 = Cardinal.aleph 4
